{{Quote|Good evenin' t'ye. I be Ars Fivvle, reportin' fer the final time on behalf o' ''Action Tidings''. Tonight, we be comin' t'ye live from the ''Action Tidings'' studio in Ugnorgrad, a city near an' dear t'me own heart.|Ars Fivvle|<ref name="Bespin: Action Tidings" />}}
The '''''Action Tidings'' studio''' was located on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]] in the [[Action Tidings Tower|''Action Tidings'' Tower]]. It was where [[Ars Fivvle]] hosted the news show ''[[Action Tidings]]'' on its last special broadcast.<ref name="Bespin: Action Tidings" />
